question: Can one stock Core2 guest complete a second external NUS GATT transaction after the peer disconnects?

baseline.interpretation: The first BLE transaction and a two-minute active-link hold pass. They do not prove a second connection in the same guest.

variants.name: stock-advertising-lifecycle
variants.guest_changes: none; stock BLEUARTServer calls gap_advertise immediately from the disconnect IRQ

variants.name: guest-scheduled-readvertise
variants.guest_changes: test-only ReconnectableBLEUARTServer schedules gap_advertise 500 ms after disconnect

variants.name: no-readvertise-control
variants.guest_changes: test-only IRQ override removes the connection and deliberately does not advertise again

classification.result: Bumble returned an invalid response for a no-response HCI command
confirmed: The stock and delayed-readvertising variants complete cycle 1, disconnect, then emit repeated NimBLE 'HCI process ack returned 12' and never expose a second advertisement.
The true no-readvertise control completes cycle 1 without any NimBLE reset, proving disconnect alone is harmless.
QEMU HLI delivery is ordered and error-free; connection, L2CAP and GATT pools remain available.
The external Bumble compatibility handler incorrectly returned Command Status for HCI_Host_Number_of_Completed_Packets (0x0c35).
The stale 0x0c35 ACK was consumed by the next LE Set Advertising Data command, so ble_hs_hci_process_ack returned BLE_HS_ECONTROLLER (12).
Bluetooth Core Vol 4, Part E, 7.3.35 defines no Command Complete or Command Status response for this command.
not_claimed: physical RF, bit-exact ESP32 BT controller/baseband or controller firmware equivalence
next_checks: Keep the corrected no-response handling under unit test.
Run repeated two-cycle leases and multi-cycle soak in the follow-up evidence.

root_cause.fix: return no HCI event for HCI_Host_Number_of_Completed_Packets
